title: Anti-DDI v3: an evidence framework and benchmark resource for drug non-interaction
description: Anti-DDI v3 contains 797 audited drug-pair evidence records, including 538 default T1/T2 evidence-supported Anti-DDI benchmark records, a frozen Paper 5 RIDI split, and eight post-confirmatory human clinical-pharmacology anchors. The resource is for research and benchmarking, not prescribing.
